interpretation: File presence, timestamps, DONE markers and log excerpts do not establish scientific validity or successful completion.
Sequence files and raw reads were not opened. Scripts were inventoried but their contents were not collected.
Checksums were inventoried, not recomputed or verified.
Symlinks and other filesystems were not traversed. Project audit directories were excluded.
QC previews show up to 40 initial lines; log previews show up to 60 final lines.
Focused-family files take priority in excerpts; full metadata indexes cover all inventoried files.
No scheduler history was queried. Original paths are scrubbed, but review excerpts before sharing for other sensitive content.
This is a live inventory, not an atomic snapshot; files may change during traversal.
